unity.status_note: Tier-1 bridge in Bridges/Unity (editor_status, manage_asset, read_logs, execute_script) plus Tier-2 manage_play_mode and read-only inspect_scene and Tier-3/4 mutate_scene (create/instantiate-prefab/rename/reparent/delete, single-step undoable) plus Tier-5 typed create (curated node_type vocabulary: object/camera/light_point/light_directional) and Tier-6 read-only capture_viewport (viewport PNG, viewport_unavailable refusal when headless) plus Tier-7 simulate_input (discrete keyboard/mouse delivery in play mode; optional Input System backend, input_backend_unavailable without it, REVVY_INPUT_BACKEND kill switch) plus Tier-8 manage_properties (curated list/get/set over transform/light/camera properties, one-call-one-undo, prefab-instance edits recorded as local overrides) plus Tier-9 play-mode pause/resume/step (manage_play_mode extension, frames 1-60, pending_steps reporting, simulated input observed on exactly the stepped frame) plus Tier-10 capture_viewport inline option (optional base64 image content block attached via a reserved _content_blocks key, 1 MB inline cap refused with capture_too_large before the file is written, proxy pass-through proven by SHA-256 round trip) plus Tier-11 manage_prefab (list_overrides/revert/apply of prefab-instance overrides; enumeration filters IsDefaultOverride so a pristine instance reports none and a root move is never an override, revert is one-call-one-undo, apply rewrites the source asset and is declared non-undoable with nearest-root targeting, readOnlyActions list_overrides only) plus Tier-15 override_created (per-write override reporting on manage_properties set — a before/after pair against the same predicate manage_prefab uses, so the per-property engine classification holds: an instance root's position and rotation report false while its scale reports true; additive, always present, prefab_override unchanged); package compilation, live proxy pairing E2E, real-editor mutation+instantiation E2E (Run-BridgeE2E.ps1), the real-pixel capture gate (Run-CaptureE2E.ps1), the simulated-input gate (Run-InputE2E.ps1), the properties gate (Run-PropertiesE2E.ps1), the pause/step gate (Run-PauseStepE2E.ps1), the inline-image gate (Run-InlineImageE2E.ps1), and the prefab-override gate (Run-PrefabE2E.ps1) passed on Unity 6000.3.8f1. Component attach/detach is not implemented.

godot.status_note: Tier-1 GDScript bridge plus Tier-2 manage_play_mode and read-only inspect_scene and Tier-3/4 mutate_scene (create/instantiate-packed-scene/rename/reparent/delete, single-step undoable) plus Tier-5 typed create (curated node_type vocabulary: object/camera/light_point/light_directional) and Tier-6 read-only capture_viewport (viewport PNG, viewport_unavailable refusal when headless) plus Tier-7 simulate_input (discrete keyboard/mouse delivery in play mode via Input.parse_input_event; REVVY_INPUT_BACKEND=none kill switch) plus Tier-8 manage_properties (curated list/get/set over transform/light/camera properties, one-call-one-undo, instanced-scene edits as local overrides) plus Tier-9 extended manage_play_mode descriptor (pause/resume/step ship as explicit pause_unsupported refusals with a capabilities object — Godot runs the played scene as a separate process and the 4.5 EditorInterface exposes no scriptable pause/step, confirmed against ClassDB at runtime) plus Tier-10 capture_viewport inline option (base64 image content block via the same reserved _content_blocks key lifted by the server, 1 MB inline cap refused with capture_too_large before the file is written) plus Tier-11 manage_prefab (list_overrides/revert/apply of instanced-scene overrides via reference-instance diff, EditorUndoRedoManager-wrapped revert, pack+ResourceSaver apply declared non-undoable, automatic editable-instance enabling on child writes reported as editable_enabled — the same policy also closes the manage_properties silent-loss gap; removed-override arrays are always empty because Godot has no such concept) plus Tier-15 override_created (per-write override reporting on manage_properties set — an instanced-scene root transform reports true here, the documented divergence from Unity, because Godot stores it as a genuine difference; additive, always present, prefab_override unchanged) are implemented in Bridges/Godot. Protocol smoke, live proxy pairing E2E, play-mode/scene-inspection/scene-mutation/instantiation E2E, both capture legs (windowed real-pixel + headless refusal), the simulated-input play-mode leg, the property list/get/set leg, the pause/step refusal leg, the inline-image legs (windowed real-pixel through a live proxy round trip + headless refusal), and the manage_prefab legs (windowed real-editor + cold-load apply verification) pass on Godot 4.6.1 with the harness kept on the 4.5 API baseline (worker-reported pass on 4.7.1).
